title: Normalized source-shift square for reindexed derived Hom
statement:
theorem derived_source_shift_square
    {X Y : Scheme.{u}} (g : X ⟶ Y) [IsIso g]
    [∀ x : X, Invertible (l : X.residueField x)]
    [∀ y : Y, Invertible (l : Y.residueField y)]
    [EssentiallySmall.{u + 1} X.ProEt] [EssentiallySmall.{u + 1} Y.ProEt] (s : Option ℕ)
    (SX : Closed l E X s) (SY : Closed l E Y s)
    (TX : Models l E X s SX) (TY : Models l E Y s SY)
    (c : Comparison l E g s SX SY TX TY)
    (M N : podReindexingDerived l E Y s) (a : ℤ) :
    c.derived.hom.app (op (M⟦a⟧), N) ≫
      (podReindexingDerivedHom l E X s).map
        (Prod.mkHom (((podReindexingDerivedFunctor l E g s).commShiftIso a).inv.app M).op
          (𝟙 ((podReindexingDerivedFunctor l E g s).obj N))) ≫
      (CategoryTheory.RingedHomUniverses.sourceShift.{u + 1, u, u, u + 2}
        (ProEt.topology X) (podReindexingRing l E X s)
        ((podReindexingDerivedFunctor l E g s).obj M) a).inv.app
          ((podReindexingDerivedFunctor l E g s).obj N) =
    (podReindexingDerivedFunctor l E g s).map
      ((CategoryTheory.RingedHomUniverses.sourceShift.{u + 1, u, u, u + 2}
        (ProEt.topology Y) (podReindexingRing l E Y s) M a).inv.app N) ≫
      ((podReindexingDerivedFunctor l E g s).commShiftIso (-a)).hom.app
        ((podReindexingDerivedHom l E Y s).obj (op M, N)) ≫
      (c.derived.hom.app (op M, N))⟦-a⟧'

source.place: Step 4; the source-variable part of the representative signed-shift argument in lem-pod-reindexing-shift-derived-model.

proof.text: represent the source by a complex and resolve the target by a K-injective complex. Apply `Comparison.derived_model` to the source and its shift. The normalization `LeftNormalization` for `sourceShift` expresses both vertical maps as localizations of signed source reindexing. Apply each Hom-product projection: both routes reindex the factor by the source shift and multiply degree r by (-1)^(a*r), while `chain_projection` identifies their unshifted factors. Product extensionality proves the chain equality. Localize it and cancel the Hom-model and localization factor isomorphisms. Naturality along the chosen resolution and source presentation gives the square for M and N.

proof_origin.place: Step 4; isolate source shift compatibility, then paste the two independent squares using naturality and CommShift addition coherence.
